description: This Java class 'LoanScheduleComponent' manages the update of loan repayment schedules, including adding, copying, and removing installments, and updating derived fields related to loan schedules.

classes.name: LoanScheduleComponent
classes.description: Component class responsible for updating loan repayment schedules, managing installments, and recalculating dependent fields.

methods.name: updateLoanSchedule
methods.description: Updates the loan schedule based on a modified schedule model, adding or updating installments, and removing obsolete ones.

methods.name: updateLoanSchedule
methods.description: Updates the loan schedule with a list of installments, adding new or updating existing installments, and removing missing ones.

methods.name: findByInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Finds a loan repayment installment by its installment number within a collection.

methods.name: existInstallment
methods.description: Checks if an installment exists in a collection by installment number.

methods.name: existInstallment
methods.description: Checks if an installment number exists within a list of schedule model periods.
